recognize_zh: 閘選的細胞幾乎全部落在 CD13+33 陽性區，其中一大部分同時表現 CD34（Q2），並延續到 CD34 陰性區（Q4），顯示這群芽細胞為骨髓系並表現 CD34。
features: Dot plot of CD13+CD33 (PE, combined) versus CD34 (APC) on gated cells
Essentially all events are CD13/CD33 positive (right quadrants)
A large subset co-expresses CD34 (upper right quadrant Q2)
Remaining CD13/33-positive events extend continuously into the CD34-negative quadrant (Q4)
Virtually no events in CD13/33-negative quadrants (Q1, Q3)
describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of left knee joint fluid displays CD13/CD33 versus CD34 expression on the gated population. The cells are uniformly positive for the myeloid antigens CD13/CD33, and a substantial subset co-expresses CD34, with a continuum into a CD34-negative fraction. Because CD13 and CD33 share one fluorochrome, individual antigen expression cannot be separated on this plot, and the exact gating strategy is not shown. Findings support a CD34-positive myeloid blast population, consistent with joint fluid involvement by acute myeloid leukemia.
